name: stack_ready_carries_into_window
description: A Ready said during a wave whose horn never sounded stands into the window that opens (contract-m8 §2, design 2.7: open_window clears no present seat's Ready said in the wave before it). Two present seats, no towers, 200 lives (a setter): seat 1 calls wave 2 during wave 1, seat 2 never does, so no stacked horn sounds and wave 1 clears alone. In the window seat 1 is still Ready and the horn waits only for seat 2; its Ready sounds it at once, paying both seats a gold for each whole second left. Seat 1 pressed nothing in the window.

steps.assert: clear.size() == 1 and clear[0][1] == 1 and clear[0][2] == 0 and scene.rows('WAVE', ['wave'], {'start': true}) == [[1]]
steps.msg: wave 1 cleared alone into a window: the stacked horn waited for seat 2 the whole wave

steps.assert: scene.client(1).hollows[0].phase == 0 and scene.client(1).seat(1).ready and not scene.client(1).seat(2).ready
steps.msg: seat 1's Ready from the wave stands in the window
the window horn waits for seat 2
seat 2's Ready sounds the window's horn at once
both seats paid the window's seconds left
seat 1 said Ready twice only, at the first horn and during wave 1
